en: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
A revelation from He who created the earth
The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ
en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth
and what is between them and what is under the soil.
then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
Allah - there is no deity except Him.
To Him belong the best names.
And has the story of Moses reached you? -
